_about: Adapter catalogue (#62, spec #55). Read by orch-product-team when it proposes a stack at kickoff and by pipeline.js for the design phase's Stack section; no always-loaded rule refers to it. Fixture paths are relative to the claude-setup repository root (fixtures are not installed into product repositories).

statuses.proven: fixture green in CI and at least one product built with it
statuses.planned: no adapter yet: choosing this stack needs one of the unsupported-stack options

unsupportedOptions.supported alternative: choose a stack whose adapter is proven or experimental
unsupportedOptions.weaker gate: run an existing adapter without the checks it cannot run; the missing checks are recorded in decisions.md and in verify.config.json weakerGate, and verify.js prints them on every run
unsupportedOptions.adapter first: build the adapter first, as its own spec, then continue this product

stacks: JavaScript or TypeScript on Node.js, tests on node:test (TypeScript through Node's type stripping)
limits: .tsx and .jsx files are not supported (Node's type stripping does not handle JSX)
the type check runs only when typecheck.command is set

stacks: Vite + React + TypeScript: Vitest, Stryker on the vitest runner, Playwright
limits: Stryker's TypeScript checker is off by default; tsc --noEmit runs once as the required type check

stacks: a project whose runner the gate reads JUnit XML from: vitest or playwright

missingChecks.when: the main runner writes no lcov (playwright)

limits: report contract proven with a stand-in runner only
vitest runner proven through the vitest-stryker fixture
playwright as the main runner unproven
each missing check needs the owner's weaker-gate decision in design.md's Stack section and in verify.config.json weakerGate
